articles.summary: IRVINE, Calif. (Jan. 10, 2023) – American Healthcare REIT, Inc., a self-managed, publicly registered, real estate investment trust, announced today the appointments of Marvin O’Quinn and Valerie Richardson to the company’s board of directors, effective January 10, 2023.
articles.title: American Healthcare REIT Appoints Marvin O’Quinn and Valerie Richardson to Board of Directors
